It did not establish a universal worker configuration or a machine-wide throughput ceiling. Later autonomy work superseded that knob-centric operating model: scenario-aware control exceeded 1k PGCR/sec on normal historical backparse and 2k PGCR/sec from parser-owned S3, while latency, slow-edge, OOM, failed-row, and cache-high-water evidence showed that fetch, DB lanes, batch size, and rollup behavior must adapt reversibly to current pressure. answer.answer: Straylight is a user-owned, portable, agent-first context and durable-work layer. The correction expands its boundary from learned memory and retrieval to durable machine continuity: preserving the evidence and live work state needed for a fresh agent to resume, advance, verify, revise, checkpoint, and hand off complex work. Obsidian is a prototype corpus and human-readable projection—not the canonical product. The first retrieval-only benchmark is now a regression baseline; the expanded gate must demonstrate better real-work continuation and correct durable next-state creation.

claims.value: Straylight is a user-owned, portable agent context and durable-work layer for durable machine continuity. It is not primarily a notes app, wiki, synchronized folder, transcript archive, retrieval product/system, or memory database; its agent-first purpose is to let otherwise disconnected agent runtimes learn, continue, and iteratively advance complex research, planning, implementation, operations, verification, and handoff work.

Beyond learned durable knowledge, Straylight must preserve the live state required to resume and advance work: goals, evidence, decisions, hypotheses, plans, artifacts, computations, unresolved/open questions, rejected paths or approaches, checkpoints, current state, working sets, and resumable next actions. A later agent must be able to inspect how that state was reached, reopen and query it, compute over it, revise it as evidence changes, verify it, checkpoint it, and leave a better durable state for the next agent. Full sources, artifacts, versions, corrections, provenance, authority, valid time, and transaction time remain available; summaries, embeddings, indexes, consolidated memories, and context packs are derived aids rather than truth boundaries.

Obsidian is not the product boundary because Straylight's canonical interaction model is agent-first, while Obsidian and Markdown serve as prototype/evaluation corpora, human-readable projections, and export formats. Metis is the distinct project that organizes the human knowledge base and supplies the first representative corpus; Straylight is the portable agent context and durable-work product designed over corpora of that kind. Raw Markdown is therefore not assumed to be Straylight's only or canonical storage representation.

The first benchmark was too narrow because it measured retrieval readiness rather than the whole product: 20 frozen questions and 53 gold evidence items over 44 non-private notes, comparing direct full-file access, one-shot BM25 top-k, and a minimal deterministic workspace that exercised `memory.open`, `memory.query`, and `memory.read`; model-directed `memory.compute` and `memory.verify` were untested. Policy 0.2 and one-shot top-k each passed 17 of 20 cases, but one-shot recovered 48 of 53 evidence items versus the workspace's 46 of 53 and used about 1,070 mean estimated tokens versus 2,932, so the workspace hypothesis was not demonstrated and policy 0.2 is only a frozen regression baseline, not holdout evidence. The expanded evaluation must compare direct filesystem access with search/range reads/scripts, a model-directed agent workspace using `open`, `query`, `read`, `compute`, `verify`, checkpoint, and revision behavior, and a fixed handoff/context pack. On real Warmind/Charlemagne performance and incident work, StarRupture factory planning, Switzerland trip planning under changing constraints, and Straylight's own evolution, it must prove that a fresh agent can resume, iterate, compute, verify before acting, reason through temporal changes, supersession and contradictions, inspect full sources, advance the work, and leave correct durable next-state and handoff artifacts. Retrieval recall remains a regression lane; no canonical storage-engine decision is allowed until a blinded model-answer evaluation tests model-directed workspace calls against an untouched holdout set.
